body: Would you mind checking this in webpack@2?

This might be a problem with extract-text-webpack-plugin (or with child compiler handling), or at least I encountered a similar issue a few months ago with `webpack@2.1.0-beta.21` + `extract-text-webpack-plugin@2.1.0-beta.3`.

On every build that used the `recordsPath`, the `"extract-text-webpack-plugin"` array in the records JSON would be appended with a new modules/chunks object.

This was a "disposable" project so I didn't pay it much mind, and I periodically delete the records anyway to re-optimize the chunk IDs.

issue.body: **Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?** A bug. **What is the current behavior?** HotModuleReplacementPlugin doesn't generate hot update assets when applied to child compilation. **If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.** 1. Clone gist https://gist.github.com/kisenka/836a47f9053647683cb3fb0f2a5ba82e. 2. `npm install && npm start`. 3. Open http://localhost:8080. This is page with 2 entry points: main-entry.js and compiled by child compilation child-entry.js. 4. Open developer console, Network tab. 5. Make some edits in `src/styles.css`. 6. Network tab will looks like: Child entry point HMR runtime trying to request updates, but is 404 returned. **What is the expected behavior?** Hot update assets from child compilation should be generated and emitted. **Please mention other relevant information such as the browser version, Node.js version, webpack version and Operating System.** nodejs: 6.9.1 webpack: 2.2.1 OS: macOS Sierra **Details for better understanding** When dev server starts - it's ok, compilation hashes in HMR runtime matches for both compilations: main and child. ![entrypoints](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/2714771/23030845/0a01a8d0-f480-11e6-9f9b-ed4d9cb6ccab.png) After some changes in src/styles.css HotModuleReplacementPlugin emit hot update assets from main compilation, but not assets was generated from child compilation: ![recompilation](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/2714771/23031078/c9043fa4-f480-11e6-94c4-3d41d58103e1.png) So when HMR runtime of child entry point trying to get updates - 404 is returned:
